title: What is your opinion on submission quality since the `vibecoding` tag was removed?
content_html:
Were concerns about its removal real, or has its absence moderated content to be higher quality?

Were there any unexpected consequences?

Is anyone willing to admit that their hope for its removal, or fear of its removal was misplaced?

Is lobsters better or worse without it?
